parsed.basis: Saint Peter Basseterre is the parish containing Basseterre, the capital and main tourist and port centre of Saint Kitts, with hotels, restaurants and cruise and expatriate traffic making it more anonymous and commercially accustomed to foreign visitors than rural areas. The national regime applies: consensual adult same-sex conduct has been lawful since the 2022 Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court ruling, and no trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban or documented police targeting of visitors is known. However there is no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection for gender identity, discrimination in work, housing and services remains lawful, and LGBTQ people are reported to avoid police, limiting recourse after harassment or assault. A visitor uses home-issued documents and cannot obtain local marker changes.
